product_summary: Benepik (benepik.com) is a B2B rewards, engagement and loyalty SaaS platform, not a construction/DIY supplier. Real product lines per its own site: (1) Rewards & Recognition platform (employee R&R, points, digital certificates/badges); (2) Channel Partner Loyalty (campaigns, incentive automation, KYC, WhatsApp/web/app); (3) Consumer Loyalty (QR scan, bill upload, gamification); (4) Corporate Gifting — curated kits/hampers for onboarding, festivals, work anniversaries, Women's Day, maternity, with 'zero inventory' on-demand fulfilment and '10K+ products' catalogue; (5) Gift Cards and Gift Card API ('Say Cheers'); (6) 'Bundle of Joy' benefits bundle (tele-consult, pharmacy discounts, health check-ups, roadside assistance, personal accident insurance); (7) Electronic goods as redemption rewards; (8) UPI/bank-transfer payout of reward points. Address: 856, 8th Floor, Tower B2, Spaze I-Tech Park, Sector 49, Gurugram, Haryana.
comment: HS 491110 (trade catalogues/advertising print) does not describe this business. Benepik is a software/platform and rewards-fulfilment aggregator: its core output is a SaaS loyalty platform (services, ch. 99) plus resold gift cards, gift hampers and electronics sourced from third parties — i.e. a trader/aggregator, not a manufacturer of printed matter. Industry classification 'Строительство и DIY' (construction & DIY) is a clear misclassification: nothing on the site relates to construction materials, tools or DIY; the correct industry is IT/software + marketing services + corporate gifting. Product lines entirely missing from the declaration: SaaS platform, gift cards/API, electronics redemption catalogue, insurance/health benefit bundle, UPI payouts. If any physical goods are actually exported, the plausible codes are 491199 (printed gift vouchers/cards) or the mixed contents of gift hampers (which cannot be captured by a single HS-6), but no customs line was reviewed here, so all physical-goods claims are 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Per project rule 3 the company is retained; the code should be corrected to the actual activity (services/software, with 491110 dropped or narrowed to printed catalogues only). Sources: https://benepik.com/ , https://www.benepik.com/about-us , https://benepik.com/corporate-gifting/ . No registry, revenue or shipment data researched per role scope.
